title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Amos 7: the visions of the locusts, the fire and the plumb line, and the clash between Amos and Amaziah the priest of Bethel.

questions.text: In the first vision of this chapter, what did the Lord Yahweh form?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh showed Amos locusts, formed at the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth.

questions.text: What reason did Amos give when he begged, “Lord Yahweh, forgive”?
questions.explanation: Amos asked how Jacob could stand, because he is small.

answers.text: The harvest is not yet in

questions.text: How did Yahweh answer after Amos pleaded about the locusts?
questions.explanation: Yahweh relented concerning this and said, “It shall not be.”

answers.text: He relented and said it would not be
He sent the locusts out at once
He gave Amos no answer at all
He told Amos to plead no more

questions.text: In the second vision, what did the Lord Yahweh call for?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh called for judgment by fire, which dried up the great deep and would have devoured the land.

questions.text: What did Amos say he saw when Yahweh asked him what he saw beside the wall?
questions.explanation: The Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumb line, with a plumb line in his hand, and Amos said he saw a plumb line.

questions.text: Against whose house did Yahweh say he would rise with the sword?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said the sanctuaries of Israel would be laid waste and that he would rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.

questions.text: Who was Amaziah, who sent word to Jeroboam king of Israel about Amos?
questions.explanation: Amaziah was the priest of Bethel, and he sent word that Amos had conspired against the king.

questions.text: Where did Amaziah tell Amos to flee?
questions.explanation: Amaziah told Amos to flee away into the land of Judah and to prophesy there.

questions.text: How did Amos describe his own work before he was sent?
questions.explanation: Amos answered that he was no prophet and no prophet's son, but a herdsman and a farmer of sycamore figs.

answers.text: A priest who served in the sanctuary
A singer who played before the king
A keeper of vineyards in Judah
A herdsman and a farmer of sycamore figs

questions.text: Where did Yahweh say Amaziah himself would die?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that Amaziah would die in a land that is unclean, and that Israel would be led away captive out of his land.

answers.text: In a land that is unclean
